about: Test description of the Parks case. The answer key is answer_key.json (made from answer_sheet.doc); the lines, steps, and notes are in source/cases/parks.js. This file tells the tests which PDF goes with each step.
pdfWhy: Steps N and O (no change expected from Step M; O makes next year's estimate vouchers) have no step printouts, so they use Parks_Golden.pdf, the instructors' final Quality Review printout ('JA Parks GOLDEN Ver 2.pdf', November 20, 2026, which has the four estimate vouchers Step O makes), whose values match Step M.
todoWhy: Steps C, D, K, and O each leave one TS Note box for the student to tick (the answer sheet marks NN at C, D, and K, and its TS Note examples include Step O).
ownTsNoteBoxWhy: Each of these steps keeps its own TS Note box: ticking one must not tick another.
